title: Credits and licences
summary: Ultimate Client Manager stands on a lot of other people’s work. This page credits it and tells you where to find the licence terms that come with each piece.
html:
Your licence

Your purchase from CodeCanyon grants you an Envato Market licence — the Regular Licence or the Extended Licence, depending on which you bought. The terms are published at codecanyon.net/licenses/standard.

That licence covers the application code, stylesheets, images and design created for this product. It does not cover the third-party components listed below, which stay under their own licences.

The full manifest

The complete list — every component, its version, its licence, its copyright holder, where it came from and where it lives inside the download — is in the Licensing folder next to this documentation.

  • Third party libraries — The manifest, as a table you can read in a browser.
  • Licensing notes — How the Envato licence and the component licences fit together.

The full text of every licence referenced there is in Licensing/licenses/.

If those links do not open

They point one folder up from this documentation, which only works if you kept the download’s folder structure. If you moved this folder somewhere on its own, open the Licensing folder from the original download instead.

What is included, in brief

Around fifty third-party components ship inside the application. The ones you are most likely to notice:

ComponentUsed forLicence
dompdfTurning invoices and quotes into PDFs.LGPL 2.1
PHPMailerSending email, including over SMTP.LGPL 2.1
HTML PurifierCleaning HTML that people type into the editor.LGPL 2.1
TinyMCEThe rich text editor.LGPL 2.1
jQuery and jQuery UIMost of the interactive behaviour in the interface.MIT
BootstrapLayout and components in several themes.MIT
Font AwesomeThe icons.OFL 1.1 and MIT
AdminLTEThe AdminLTE theme.MIT
PluploadUploading files, including large ones in pieces.GPL 2.0
phpseclibEncrypting sensitive stored values.MIT
Morris.js and RaphaëlDashboard charts.BSD and MIT
SignaturePadDrawn signatures on quotes and contracts.BSD 3-Clause

Payment gateway libraries are credited in the manifest alongside the rest.

Components under the GPL

A small number of the included components are licensed under the GNU General Public Licence rather than a permissive licence. For those components the GPL applies, and the rights it gives you — including to the source, which is included — are yours. The full GPL text is at Licensing/licenses/GPL-2.0.txt.

This does not change the licence of the rest of the product, which remains the Envato licence you bought. A product made of parts under different licences is normal; what matters is that each part keeps its own terms, which is what the manifest records.

Components whose licence we could not establish

We would rather tell you this than quietly leave it out. A handful of the bundled components arrived without a licence file or a licence header, so we cannot state their terms with confidence. They are marked in the manifest and explained individually in Licensing/licenses/UNRESOLVED.txt, which separates the ones that merely lack a copy of a well known licence from the ones where nothing is known at all.

If you are redistributing this product, or embedding it in something you sell on, read that file before you do.

Reporting a problem with attribution

If you are the author of something included here and the credit or licence is wrong or missing, please say so through the item’s comments page on CodeCanyon. It will be corrected in the next release.
